headlines.text: Looking back to 2021, when the Impact World Title made its debut as Christian Cage vs. Kenny Omega battled for the honor of being first champion, appearing on Rampage, rated 8.21 ? one of the better matches of the year. The first-ever match on AEW's brand-new Friday night show ? a shocking, near-five-star title change that saw the previously undefeated Cage dethrone Omega for the Impact World Championship, a genuine surprise that set up a bigger rematch just weeks later at All Out.
Turning the clock back to 2025: Alexander & Fletcher made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.43 ? a good, competitive contest.
Rewind to 2025, when The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) vs. LFI (Dralistico, Mortos & Rush) headlined Dynamite, rated 5.78 in an action-packed trios battle.

secondaries.text: Turning the clock back to 2021: Britt Baker vs. Red Velvet clashed for the AEW Women's World Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 5.40.
On a Wednesday in 2025, back when Jon Moxley vs. Kevin Knight crossed paths for the first time ever, kicking off the show on Dynamite, rated 6.55.
